text: {"differences": [{"side": "en", "quote": "Migros has been committed to energy efficiency and other areas of sustainability for several decades, and has been awarded the 2016 Watt d'Or in the special “Corporate strategy” category for its Generation M sustainability programme, in which it has declared its intention to reduce absolute electricity consumption by 10 percent, and greenhouse gas emissions by 20 percent versus the 2010 level, by 2020.", "severity": 0.6, "before": "Migros – Generation M\n"}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Depuis des décennies, l'efficacité énergétique et d'autres thèmes liés au développement durable sont au cœur des préoccupations de Migros.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "Migros – Génération M\n"}]}
